additionalDocuments.label: Ellington Berkeley Tower official project brief

review.gallery: Nine native renders from the official brochure, showing Berkeley Tower’s frontage, arrival and workplaces. Decorative cloud and lifestyle assets excluded.
review.location: Official project brief pages 14 and 15 show the labeled tower and fifteen driving estimates. The published vicinity pin is consistent with the developer’s site drawing next to the metro.
review.floorPlans: 26 complete official sheets. Nineteen unit or typical drawings and seven additional parking and amenity layouts. Office Type C reads 12,451.48 sq ft versus 12,182 on its floor plate. Type D reads 21,904.77 versus 21,873. Type E reads 22,090.45 versus 22,191. Each figure remains attached to its source drawing.

unavailable: The exact visitor entrance, separate retail and other office-type unit sheets and signed unit-specific schedules were not established.
